publications.title: Automated Discovery Has No Universally Superior Harness
publications.authors: Akshat Gupta, Alexander Lu, Jermaine Lei, Gopala Anumanchipalli, Leshem Choshen
publications.description: Decomposes automated-discovery systems into their core design choices and evaluates 30 budget-matched harnesses across 12 model-problem pairs with more than 3.1 million LLM rollouts. The results show that no fixed harness wins universally and motivate adaptive compute allocation guided by early performance.

publications.title: Evolutionary Strategies lead to Catastrophic Forgetting in LLMs
publications.authors: Immanuel Abdi, Akshat Gupta, Micah Mok, Alexander Lu, Nicholas Lee, Gopala Anumanchipalli
publications.description: Demonstrates that gradient-free methods like Evolutionary Strategies induce catastrophic forgetting when fine-tuning LLMs compared to GRPO, driven by denser weight updates and higher ℓ₂ gradient norms.
